description_html:
The Geekvape Z Series Coil is a replacement coil for compatible Geekvape devices.

  • Product Type: Replacement Coil
  • Coil Resistance: 0.15Ω XM / 0.25Ω Dual / 0.4Ω (Z1) / 0.2Ω (Z2)
  • Coil Material: Mesh (KA1)
  • Compatible Devices: Geekvape Zeus (Z) Sub-ohm Tanks (Z, 2021, SE, 5), Z Fli / Fli 2, and Aegis Legend 2/3/5, Aegis Max 2, Aegis Solo 3 kits
  • Pack Quantity: 5 Coils
  • Brand: Geekvape

CRC (child-resistant) version.

Coils are consumable - replace when flavour or vapour output drops.

Available options: Z2/Z 0.2OHM MESH, Z1/Z 0.4OHM MESH, Z 0.25OHM DUAL, Z 0.15OHM XM.
